Rajeev Singhal
{{small|(MD)}} | products = Cold rolled, [[galvanised]], Bhushan Galume, Tata Shaktee,colour coated tiles, drawn [[Tubing (material)|tubes]], strips, wire rods, alloy billets, [[sponge iron]] | num_employees = 5000+ | caption = | parent = Tata Steel | revenue = {{increase}} {{Currency|1.7|USD}} [[1000000000 (number)|billion]] | website = [http://www.tatasteelbsl.co.in/ Official website] }} '''Tata Steel BSL Limited''', formerly '''Bhushan Steel Limited''', was the largest manufacturer of auto-grade [[steel]] in India.{{Cite news| url = http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/articleshow/2768220.cms | title = Analysts' picks: Ambuja, Cairn India, Cadila, RCom, Bhushan Steel | newspaper = The Economic Times | date = 9 February 2008 | access-date = 19 February 2008 | publisher = The Economic Times, 9 February 2008}} == History == The company was founded on 7 January 1983 under the name Jawahar Metal Industries Private Limited in the [[Sahibabad]] Industrial Area of [[Ghaziabad district]], [[Uttar Pradesh]]. The company manufactured cold [[Rolling (metalworking)|rolled]] [[Strip steel|steel strips]] and steel [[Ingot|ingots]]. On 14 January 1987, Jawahar Metal Industries was acquired by Brij Bhushan Singal and his sons, Sanjay and Neeraj Singal. Jawahar Metal Industries was renamed as Bhushan Steel & Strips Limited on 9 June 1992. The name was changed to Bhushan Steel Limited in 2007.{{Cite web |title=Company History of Tata Steel BSL Limited |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/bhushansteel/history/bs14 |access-date=2024-04-13 |website=www.moneycontrol.com |language=en}}{{cite web |title=Performance analysis of bhushan steel limited |url=https://www.ipaicmai.in/IPANEW/UploadFiles/Casestudy/Bhushan_Power.pdf |website=Insolvency Professional Agency of Institute of Cost Accountants of India |access-date=13 April 2024}} Insolvency proceedings were initiated against the company on 26 July 2017 under the [[Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016]].{{citation |title=L&T moves NCLT to be declared as secured creditor in Bhushan Steel insolvency |url=http://www.livemint.com/Companies/ersQoSgCetf0Atx0hT1rPK/LT-moves-NCLT-to-be-declared-as-secured-creditor-in-Bhushan.html |work=[[Live Mint]] |date=8 March 2018 }}{{citation |title=First under insolvency code: Bhushan Steel bought by Tata Steel |url=http://indianexpress.com/article/business/first-under-insolvency-code-bhushan-steel-bought-by-tata-steel-5182619/ |work=[[The Indian Express]] |date=21 May 2018 }} === Merger with Tata Steel === [[Tata Steel]] acquired a 72.65% stake in Bhushan Steel on 18 May 2018 through its subsidiary Bamnipal Steel. Tata Steel paid {{INRConvert|35200|c|year=2018}} to Bhushan Steel's creditor banks, and an additional {{INRConvert|1200|c|year=2018}} over 12 months to Bhushan Steel's operational creditors.{{Cite web |last=Thomas |first=Tanya |date=2018-05-18 |title=Tata Steel buys Bhushan Steel, to settle dues of Rs35,200 crore |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/zQJ1nAquZndCvPo0baMCeO/Tata-Steel-unit-completes-acquisition-of-Bhushan-Steel.html |access-date=2024-04-13 |website=mint |language=en}} The company was renamed as Tata Steel BSL Limited on 27 November 2018.{{cite web |title=Bhushan Steel renamed as Tata Steel BSL |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/bhushan-steel-renamed-as-tata-steel-bsl-118112800592_1.html |website=Business Standard |access-date=13 April 2024 |date=28 November 2018}} On 25 April 2019, the Tata Steel board approved the merger of Tata Steel BSL and Bamnipal Steel with itself.{{cite news | url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/tata-steel-board-approves-merger-of-bamnipal-steel-tata-steel-bsl/articleshow/69045850.cms | title=Tata Steel board approves merger of Bamnipal Steel & Tata Steel BSL | first=Rakhi | last=Mazumdar | newspaper=The Economic Times | date=25 April 2019 | access-date=13 December 2020 }} The merger became effective on 11 November 2021.{{cite web |title='Effective Date' of the Composite Scheme of Amalgamation of Bamnipal Steel Limited and Tata Steel BSL Limited (formerly Bhushan Steel Limited) into and with Tata Steel Limited |url=https://www.tatasteel.com/media/14710/tata-steel-limited-announcement.pdf |website=Tata Steel |access-date=13 April 2024 |date=11 November 2021}} == Plants == The [[Khopoli]] plant in [[Maharashtra]] was commissioned in 2004 and has been producing colour-coated sheets, high-tensile steel strappings, hardened and tempered steel strips for the first time in India, along with CRCA steel to cater to the needs of the automobile industry.[https://web.archive.org/web/20130117042320/http://bhushan-group.org/khopoli.asp Bhushan Steel – Khopoli] At its Sahibabad plant in [[Ghaziabad, India|Ghaziabad]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], it has a 1700 mm mill, which produces the widest sheets in [[India]] for the automotive industry. It has highly automated systems.{{Cite web |title=Tata Steel BSL Ltd. (formerly Bhusan Steel & Strips) |url=http://www.bhushan-group.org/new_intitiatives.asp |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080417025807/http://www.bhushan-group.org/new_intitiatives.asp |archive-date=17 April 2008 |access-date=19 February 2008 |publisher=TATA Steel BSL Limited}} At its Meramandali, [[Dhenkanal, India|Dhenkanal]] Integrated steel plant in [[Odisha]], Tata Steel BSL produces hot rolled coils and has mills for hot rolling. Construction of the first phase is being carried out. ==Financial Management== Gross sales of Tata Steel BSL grew from Rs. 5 billion in 2001 to Rs. 40  billion in 2007. It earned net profits of Rs. 3.13 billion in 2007 and exported goods worth Rs. 12.57 billion. Its exports include steel for both the automotive and white goods industry and the list of countries to which it exports includes several developed countries. ==References== {{Reflist}}{{Tata Steel}}{{Tata Group}}{{Steel industry of India}} [[Category:Steel companies of India]] [[Category:Companies based in Kolkata]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Kolkata]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies established in 1983]] [[Category:1983 establishments in Uttar Pradesh]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1983]] [[Category:Companies formerly listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies formerly listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Tata Steel]] [[Category:2021 disestablishments in India]]
